original: 精霊と関わりのある里が\n実際にあったなんて…
traducao: To think a village with ties to spirits\nactually existed...

original: 教会でも、世界樹と共に精霊を奉じるけど、\nわたし達の様な教会関係者でも\n精霊と会った人なんていなかったから…
traducao: The Church reveres spirits with the World\nTree, yet none of our clergy have ever\nactually met one in person...

original: でも、もし、精霊に話を聞けて、\n赤い煙について何かわかるのなら\nとても心強いよね
traducao: Still, if we can speak with a spirit\nand learn anything about that red smoke,\nit would be immensely reassuring.

original: さあ、ミブナの里へ行く方法なのだけれど、\nブラウニー坑道を通る事になるの
traducao: Now, as for reaching Mibuna Village,\nyou will pass through Brownie Mine.

original: 同行は、クラトスさん。\nそれと、ハロルドさんが行ってくれるよ
traducao: Kratos will accompany you,\nalong with Harold.

original: それじゃあ、\n気を付けて行ってらっしゃい
traducao: Well then,\nstay safe out there!

original: ねえ、クラトス。\nそのミブナの里って、\nここを通らないと行けないわけ？
traducao: Hey, Kratos.\nIs passing through here the only way\nto reach that Mibuna Village?

original: ミブナの里は、忍びの者が住む里だ。\n一般の者には見つかりづらい場所にある
traducao: Mibuna Village is home to shinobi.\nIt is hidden from ordinary people.

original: この坑道が、そこへ繋がる唯一の道だ
traducao: This mine is the sole path leading there.

original: なるほど、忍びねえ
traducao: I see. Shinobi, huh?

original: 隠密行動しないといけないなら\n外部に知られてはまずいわね
traducao: If they operate covertly, outsiders\nfinding out would indeed be troublesome.

original: それもある
traducao: That is true.

original: だが、ウリズン帝国がミブナの星晶を狙って\nいるという話もあるのでな
traducao: However, word has it the Urizen Empire\nseeks Mibuna's Star Crystals as well.

original: ああ…、ヴェイグの故郷の星晶を採り尽くした\nサレって奴がいる国…
traducao: Ah... That country where Saleh stripped\nVeigue's homeland of its Star Crystals...

original: だから、外部の者には\n並々ならぬ警戒を抱いているはずだ
traducao: They are bound to view all outsiders\nwith extraordinary vigilance.

original: でも、何であんたは道を知ってるの？
traducao: Still, how do you know the way?

original: ミブナの里の近くに、\n唯一忍びと交流のある村がある。\n私はそこから来た
traducao: Near Mibuna Village lies the only\nsettlement that communes with shinobi.\nI came from there.

original: ふ〜ん、そりゃまた珍しいわね
traducao: Hmm, now that's quite a rarity.

original: 道、無いじゃない。\nこっちであってんの？
traducao: There's no path here!\nAre we really going the right way?

original: ふうん。\n忍びが作った隠し通路ってワケね
traducao: Hmm. A hidden passage\ncrafted by shinobi, then.

original: …行くぞ
traducao: ...Let us proceed.

original: 何を読んでいる？\nそれは何だ？
traducao: What are you reading?\nWhat is that paper?

original: そこに落ちてた紙。\n新興宗教の勧誘チラシよ
traducao: Found it lying around.\nIt's a recruitment flyer for a new cult.

original: こんな人のいない所にまで布教だなんて、\nご苦労な事よね〜
traducao: Proselytizing in a deserted place like\nthis... Talk about dedicated!

original: 暁の従者…、\nディセンダーの出現を待つ集団か
traducao: Servants of the Dawn...\nA faction awaiting the Descender?

original: 世界の危機が訪れた時に現れるディセンダー、\nね〜
traducao: A Descender who appears whenever\na world crisis arrives, eh?

original: まあ、危機の感じ方って人それぞれだろうけど、\n今が危機の最たる時なワケかしら？
traducao: Well, everyone defines crisis differently,\nbut could right now be the peak of one?

original: さあな、世界の住人はヒトだけではない。\nヒト以外のものが危機を感じているならば、\nそうかもしれぬが…
traducao: Who can say. Humans are not this world's\nsole residents. If non-humans sense\na crisis, that may indeed be so...

original: わー！！　待てっ！　こらーーーーっ！！
traducao: Waaah!! Hold it! Heyyyy!!

original: なぁに、今の声？
traducao: What in the world was that voice?

original: あの声は…！
traducao: That voice...!

original: 何か、異様な気配が流れてくる。\n先を急ぐぞ
traducao: A bizarre presence is drifting our way.\nWe must make haste.

original: 先程の気配はこいつか
traducao: Is this what caused that presence?

original: ねえ、こいつと戦うの？
traducao: Say, are we fighting this thing?

original: 恐らく、門番のつもりだろう
traducao: It appears to be a gatekeeper.

original: こいつを倒さねば、ミブナの里へは\n行けそうにないだろうからな
traducao: Unless we defeat it, reaching\nMibuna Village seems impossible.

original: やっぱり〜！\nこれが忍びの技術なのね♪
traducao: I knew it!\nSo this is shinobi craft, is it?!

original: 面白そうだから、相手しちゃうわよ！
traducao: Looks like fun, I'll take it on!

original: さあ、忍びの技って奴を\nもっと見せなさい♪
traducao: Come now, show me more\nof what shinobi can do!

original: 倒したら、跡形もなく消えちゃった。\nと、言う事は呪術的な存在ね
traducao: Defeated, it vanished without a trace.\nMeaning it's an occult entity.

original: これは興味深いわ、グフフッ！
traducao: How fascinating, hehehe!

original: そいつは人工精霊だ
traducao: That was an artificial spirit.

original: 人工精霊〜？
traducao: An artificial spirit...?

original: しいな。\nお前だったか…
traducao: Sheena.\nSo it was you...

original: クラトスだったのかい！
traducao: Kratos! It's really you!

original: 久しぶりだねぇ。\nあいつを始末してくれて助かったよ
traducao: Long time no see!\nThanks for taking care of that thing.

original: あんた達が倒したのは、\nあたしが「光気丹術」で\n作ったものなんだ
traducao: What you defeated just now\nwas something I created\nusing Light Alchemy.

original: ふんふん、光気丹術っていうのね！\nワクワクしちゃう〜★
traducao: Aha, Light Alchemy, you say!\nHow exciting!

original: 扱いきれなくて暴走しちまってさ…
traducao: I couldn't control it and it ran wild...

original: もしあれが外に出たら大変だったよ\nありがとう
traducao: If it had escaped outside, we'd have been\nin serious trouble. Thank you.

original: ところで何の用だったんだい？
traducao: By the way, what brings you here?

original: 精霊と話がしたい。\n会わせてはくれないか？
traducao: We wish to speak with a spirit.\nCould you grant us an audience?

original: ミブナの里の精霊にかい？\n前は精霊と交流があったけど、今はいないよ
traducao: With the spirits of Mibuna Village?\nWe used to commune, but none remain now.

original: ミブナの里周辺の星晶が採取され始めてから、\nいなくなったんだ
traducao: Once Star Crystals around Mibuna Village\nstarted being mined, they vanished.

original: ウリズン帝国か…
traducao: The Urizen Empire...

original: それ以外の国もだね…。\n奴ら、星晶ばかりじゃなく、土地にあるものを\n何でも取っていこうとする
traducao: And other countries too...\nThose vultures take everything this land\nhas, not just Star Crystals.

original: ミブナの里が奴らに見つかるのも\n時間の問題だよ
traducao: It's only a matter of time before\nMibuna Village is discovered by them.

original: だから、奴らが入って来れない様にって、\n人工精霊を作ろうとしたんだ
traducao: That's why I tried making artificial\nspirits to keep intruders out.

original: でも、難しくてダメだったね。\nあたしなりの解釈だったんだけど、\n結局あの程度さ
traducao: Too difficult, though.\nIt was just my own take on the craft,\nand that was all I could manage.

original: んー、とりあえず、精霊への接触は\nムリって事ね
traducao: Hmm, so reaching a spirit here\nis out of the question, then.

original: どうする？　引き返す？
traducao: Let us withdraw.

original: そうだな
traducao: Indeed.

original: 待ちなよ！\nあんたが精霊を頼るって事は、\n余程の事なんだね
traducao: Wait up!\nFor you to rely on spirits, something\nterrible must be happening.

original: ミブナの里に精霊はいないけど、\n他の地域にいる精霊についてだったら、\n何かわかるかもしれないよ
traducao: We have no spirits in Mibuna Village,\nbut our lore might reveal something\nabout spirits in other regions.

original: あら、いいわね〜！
traducao: Oh, now that sounds lovely!

original: 里に文献があるんだ。\n後であんた達のギルドに届けにいくよ
traducao: We keep texts in the village.\nI'll deliver them to your guild later.

original: わかった。\nでは、それを待つとしよう
traducao: Understood.\nWe shall await your arrival.

original: ああ、待ってておくれよ！
traducao: Yeah, sit tight till then!

original: 精霊に会えなかったのは残念だけど、\nまだ望みが絶たれたわけじゃないでしょ？
traducao: Failing to meet a spirit is unfortunate,\nbut all hope isn't lost yet, right?

original: しいなさんの来船を待ちましょ
traducao: Let's wait for Sheena's arrival.

original: それにしても、人工精霊や\n光気丹術の存在を知る事が出来たのは\n私にとって大収穫だわ〜
traducao: Even so, discovering artificial spirits\nand Light Alchemy was a huge harvest\nfor me!

original: そう、その光気丹術！\nあたしが研究しているものと\n同じかもしれないのよ
traducao: Yes, that Light Alchemy!\nIt might be the very same thing\nI have been researching!

original: あらそう
traducao: Is that so?

original: んで、何を研究してたんだっけ？
traducao: And what were you researching again?

original: ソウルアルケミーよ！\n魔術の曙とでも言える太古の技術
traducao: Soul Alchemy!\nAn ancient art called the dawn of magic!

original: あら、あんたそれ研究してんの？\nでも、資料あんましないっしょ？
traducao: Oh, you're studying that?\nHardly any reference materials exist, no?

original: 私もいずれは研究したいと思ってたのよねぇ♪
traducao: I've wanted to study it eventually too!

original: うーん、でも光気丹術とソウルアルケミーの\n関連性はまだわかんないわね
traducao: Hmm, though the link between Light\nAlchemy and Soul Alchemy is still unclear.

original: 詳しく聞く為にも、\nしいなが来るのを待ちましょ
traducao: To learn more,\nlet's wait until Sheena arrives.

original: それじゃ、今回もお疲れ様。\nまた仕事を受けに来てね
traducao: Well then, thank you for your hard work.\nCome take on another job soon!

original: ええっと、ああ、あんた。\nこないだクラトスといた…
traducao: Uhm, oh, hey there.\nYou were with Kratos the other day...

original: ああ、やっぱりそうなんだね
traducao: Ah, so it really is you.

original: ○○か。\nいい名だね。\nよろしく
traducao: ○○, huh?\nNice name.\nGood to meet ya.

original: そういえば、\nちゃんと挨拶してなかったね
traducao: Come to think of it,\nI haven't introduced myself properly.

original: あたしは、しいな。\n藤林　しいなだよ
traducao: I'm Sheena.\nSheena Fujibayashi.

original: 今日は、精霊についての文献を\n持って来たんだ
traducao: I brought the ancient texts\nconcerning spirits today.

original: あら、いらっしゃい。\nようこそ、アドリビトムへ
traducao: Oh, welcome!\nWelcome to Ad Libitum.

original: えーっと、ギルドのリーダーさんだよね。\n実は、あたしをここに置いて欲しいんだよ
traducao: Uhm, you're the guild leader, right?\nTruth is, I'd like to stay here.

original: 働いてくれるのなら、構わないけど。\nでも、なぜ？
traducao: If you'll work for us, by all means.\nHowever, why the sudden request?

original: 光気丹術を使った事がばれちまって、\nほとぼりが冷めるまで里に居られなく\nなったんだよ
traducao: My use of Light Alchemy got found out,\nso I can't stay in the village\nuntil things cool down.

original: あの人工精霊は、\n侵入者専用の門番にしようと\n作ったものなんだ
traducao: I made that artificial spirit\nto serve as a gatekeeper\nspecifically against intruders.

original: でも、うちの里では\n禁呪に値するものだったからね
traducao: Yet in our village,\nit amounts to forbidden arts.

original: 里の人達にはばれてないんだけど、\n頭領だけがあたしが使ったって事を\n見抜いててさ…
traducao: The villagers didn't find out,\nbut our Chief saw right through me...\nHe knew I had cast it.

original: それで一時的に里を出る事を\nすすめられたんだよ
traducao: So he advised me to leave the village\nfor a little while.

original: それに、\nやっぱりここで働いてみたいんだ
traducao: Besides,\nI really want to work here.

original: 連れもいるんだけど、いいかい？
traducao: I've got companions with me, is that okay?

original: ええ。\nにぎやかになるから歓迎よ。\nそれじゃあ、部屋を用意しないとね
traducao: Yes, you are very welcome!\nThe more the merrier.\nNow then, we must prepare your rooms.

original: ねえ、○○。\n一緒に部屋へ来てちょうだい。\n部屋の準備の手伝い、お願いね
traducao: Say, ○○.\nCome with us to the room, please.\nHelp us get it ready, won't you?

original: 会釈をする
traducao: Nod politely

original: 自己紹介をする
traducao: Introduce yourself

original: これでいいかな。\n部屋は、ここを使ってちょうだいね
traducao: This should do.\nPlease feel free to use this room.

original: ありがとう。\nそうそう、連れの紹介もしないとね
traducao: Thanks!\nOh right, let me introduce the others.

original: 俺は、ロイド。\nロイド・アーヴィング。\nよろしくな
traducao: I'm Lloyd.\nLloyd Irving.\nNice to meet you!

original: 私はコレット。\nコレット・ブルーネルです。\nこれからお世話になります
traducao: I am Colette.\nColette Brunel.\nI'll be in your care from now on.

original: 藤林　すずです
traducao: I am Suzu Fujibayashi.

original: 故郷を出るのは初めてです。\nここで、外の世界について\n勉強させて下さい
traducao: This is my first time leaving my homeland.\nPlease allow me to learn about\nthe outside world here.

original: あたしとすずは姓が一緒だけど、\n繋がりはないんだ
traducao: Suzu and I share the same surname,\nbut we aren't related.

original: これは「あざな」で、\nあたしらの本名は、また違うんだよ
traducao: It is an alias.\nOur true names are entirely different.

original: 本名は、本人や両親、名付け親、頭領の他、\n結婚相手のみしか知る事はありません。\nご了承下さい
traducao: True names are known only to oneself,\nparents, godparents, Chief, and spouse.\nWe ask for your understanding.

original: へえぇ、変わった習慣ね
traducao: My, what a peculiar custom.

original: 精霊の居場所は、文献から特定しておくれ
traducao: Find where spirits dwell from the texts.

original: 暗号になっていて、\nあたしでは正確にわからないんだ
traducao: It's written in cipher,\nso I can't decipher it accurately.

original: ありがとう。\n文献の解読はみんなで行うわ
traducao: Thank you.\nWe shall all work together to decode it.

original: それじゃあ、部屋は自由に使ってね。\nごゆっくり
traducao: Feel free to make yourselves at home.\nRest up and take your time!

original: しいながアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Sheena has joined Ad Libitum.

original: ロイドがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Lloyd has joined Ad Libitum.

original: コレットがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Colette has joined Ad Libitum.

original: すずがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Suzu has joined Ad Libitum.

original: ねえ、しいな。\n光気丹術について聞きたいんだけど
traducao: Hey, Sheena.\nI want to ask you about Light Alchemy.

original: 悪いね。\nあれは、外部の者には教えられないんだ
traducao: Sorry.\nI can't teach that to outsiders.

original: 興味本位で言ってるんじゃないわ
traducao: I'm not asking out of idle curiosity.

original: 今、ヒトや植物、ううん、それだけじゃない。\nあらゆるモノを変異させてしまう現象が\n各地で起こってるの
traducao: Across the world, people, plants, and all\nmanner of things are mutating right now.\nIt's happening everywhere.

original: 何だって…？
traducao: What did you say...?

original: その仕組みはわかってないけど、\nひょっとしたらあんたの里に伝わるそれが、\n解決の糸口になるかもしれないのよ
traducao: We don't understand the mechanism, but\nwhat's handed down in your village\nmight be the clue to solving it!

original: ○○。\n本当の話かい
traducao: ○○.\nIs that really true?

original: わかった。\nあんたを信じるよ
traducao: Understood.\nI believe you.

original: わかった。\nそういう事なら協力するよ
traducao: Understood.\nIf that's the case, I'll cooperate.

original: これが「光気丹術経」
traducao: This is the Tome of Light Alchemy.

original: 人工精霊の作り方や何やら載ってるけど、\nあんたにわかるかい？\nあたしには、さっぱりだよ
traducao: It details making artificial spirits,\nbut can you make sense of it?\nIt's completely beyond me.

original: わからないならわかるまで、\n調べ尽くすまでよ
traducao: If I don't understand it, I'll research\nuntil I do. That's all there is to it.

original: 他に、あの怪現象を解明する手立てが\nないんだもの
traducao: We have no other way\nto unravel this mystery, after all.

original: うなずく
traducao: Nod in agreement

original: しいなに協力を請う
traducao: Ask for Sheena's cooperation

original: 光気丹術経、ざっと目を通してみたけど。\nやっぱり、これはソウルアルケミーの\n技術の一端よ
traducao: I skimmed the Tome of Light Alchemy.\nAs expected, it is a facet of the\nart of Soul Alchemy.

original: こないだが聞いた、\n魔術の曙な技術だな！
traducao: That's the art called dawn of magic\nwe heard about recently, yeah!

original: でも、それは一体どういうものなの？
traducao: What kind of art is that, exactly?

original: 根底にある理論として、\nまず全ての物質は「ドクメント」を\n持ってる、って事よ
traducao: As its fundamental theory,\nall matter possesses a Document\nto begin with.

original: ドクメント？
traducao: A Document?

original: 見せた方が早いんじゃない？
traducao: Wouldn't showing it be much faster?

original: そうね、じゃあメルディ。\nちょっと協力して
traducao: True. Meredy,\nlend me a hand for a moment.

original: はいな！
traducao: Sure thing!

original: 見てて
traducao: Watch closely.

original: バイバ！\nメルディが周りに輪っかが出来たよぅ
traducao: Baiba!\nA ring appeared around Meredy, wow!

original: これが、ドクメント。\nメルディの情報、あるいは設計書\nみたいなものと思って
traducao: This is a Document.\nThink of it as Meredy's information,\nor an informational blueprint.

original: 物質はまず、このドクメントという\nエネルギー体ありきなの
traducao: All matter exists primarily through\nthis energy body known as a Document.

original: 自分の設計書を持って、みんな生まれてくる。\nこれは生命の営みでもあるの
traducao: Everyone is born with their own blueprint.\nIt is the very essence of life.

original: そして、さらに細かく見ると…
traducao: Looking even closer...

original: これは潜在能力とか、病気になりうる要素とか、\n設計書のさらに細かい所ね
traducao: Here are latent talents, disease factors,\nand other finer details of the blueprint.

original: ドクメントと物質体は、\n互いにフィードバックしあってるの
traducao: A Document and its physical form\nconstantly provide feedback to each other.

original: 治癒術ってのは、実はここに干渉して\n傷や疲労を治したりするの。\nみんな知らずに使ってるけど
traducao: Healing artes actually interfere here\nto heal wounds and fatigue.\nPeople use them without ever knowing.

original: いわゆる「呪い」って奴も、\n実はこのドクメントに干渉して\n相手にダメージを刷り込むわけ
traducao: What we call a 'curse' also interferes\nwith this Document to imprint damage\nupon an opponent.

original: このソウルアルケミーは、\nドクメントをいじったり、\n作り出したりする技術
traducao: This Soul Alchemy is the technique\nof manipulating\nand creating Documents.

original: ミブナの里に伝わる人工精霊も\nこれの応用よ
traducao: The artificial spirits of Mibuna Village\nare an application of this.

original: ドクメントの中の、\nヒトをヒトたらしめている設計を\nいじる事が出来るんだもの
traducao: After all, you can alter the design\nwithin a Document\nthat makes a human human.

original: ヒトの存在や形を変えてしまう事も\n出来るかもしれないわね
traducao: It could very well be capable of\naltering a human's form and existence.

original: なるほど。\n生物変化は、この仕組みで\n起こっているかもしれないのね
traducao: I see.\nCreature mutations might be occurring\nthrough this very mechanism.

original: じゃあ、ドクメントを閉じるわね
traducao: Now then, I'll close the Document.

original: メルディ、何か、クラクラするよ〜
traducao: Meredy feel all dizzy...

original: ごめん。\n無理をさせてしまったわね
traducao: Sorry.\nI pushed you too hard.

original: 本来、不可視のものを、今は無理矢理\n可視状態にしてるから、被験者には\n負担がかかってしまうのよ
traducao: Forcing something invisible to manifest\nin a visible state places quite a burden\nupon the subject.

original: 細かいドクメントの展開も危険ね。\n本当は細かいトコまで解析させて\nもらいたいけど
traducao: Unfolding detailed Documents is risky too.\nThough I'd love to analyze those fine\ndetails thoroughly, truth be told.

original: 人工精霊は、どうやって出来ているの？
traducao: How are artificial spirits created?

original: 人工精霊は、人工的にドクメントを作り出す\nところから始まるわ
traducao: Creating an artificial spirit begins\nby fashioning an artificial Document.

original: ドクメントは、精妙な非物質エネルギー。\n術者の念、自然界の気なんかを\n掛け合わせてドクメントを作るの
traducao: A Document is subtle immaterial energy.\nYou combine intent and natural energy\nto construct a Document.

original: んで、その人工ドクメントエネルギーの\n振動数を、濃密な状態へ落とすと\n実体化するってワケ
traducao: Then, lowering the vibration of that\nartificial Document energy to a dense\nstate materializes it.

original: あ、ほら。\n聖者が何もない所から、食べ物や衣類を出して\n人々に与えたって話とかあるでしょ？
traducao: You know the legends of saints producing\nfood and clothing out of nothing\nto grant to the people?

original: あれは、この技術の為と言われてるわ
traducao: They say that was thanks to this art.

original: マナ、自然界の気、術者の意識をもって\n非物質状態でドクメントを構成して
traducao: With mana, nature's energy, and intent,\nyou construct a Document immaterially,

original: そのドクメントの振動数を落としてやると\n物質になっていくのよ
traducao: and lowering its vibrational frequency\nturns it into physical matter.

original: それは……神の力…？
traducao: Is that... the power of gods...?

original: まあ、術者の精神力や技量によって\nまちまちよ
traducao: Well, it varies greatly depending on\nthe caster's willpower and skill.

original: そこまでの力を持つ様な\n精神力の持ち主は\n滅多にいないと思うわ
traducao: Hardly anyone possesses\nthe mental fortitude required\nto wield such great power.

original: この技術は、そうそう簡単に\n使えるもんじゃないわね
traducao: This art isn't something\nanyone can just pick up and use.

original: キール君、\n精霊の居場所の特定は\nまだかなあ？
traducao: Keele,\nhave you located\nwhere the spirits dwell yet?

original: まだかかりそうだ。\nミブナの里の文献は、この上なく\nひねくれた暗号で書かれてるからな
traducao: It will take more time.\nThe texts from Mibuna Village are written\nin an exceedingly convoluted cipher.

original: 容易に秘密を知られては困りますので、\n身内にもわからない様に\n記してあるはずです
traducao: Secrets must not be easily revealed,\nso it was recorded to be unintelligible\neven to our own people.

original: しかし、これじゃあ書いた本人も、\n解読法を忘れるんじゃないのか…？
traducao: At this rate, even the author would\nforget how to decode it, wouldn't they...?

original: アンジュさん。\n「例の存在に会いたい」と護衛の依頼が\n届きました
traducao: Ange.\nAn escort request arrived seeking\nto meet 'that very entity.'

original: 赤い煙…。\n願いを叶えるという存在ね…
traducao: The red smoke...\nThe entity said to grant wishes...

original: …依頼内容によれば、場所はルバーブ連山ね。\n依頼者には悪いけど、わたし達は、\nその存在を追いましょう！
traducao: According to the request, the location\nis Rhubarb Mountains. We must pursue that\nentity, even if we turn the client away!

original: 了解しました
traducao: Understood.

original: ルバーブ連山。\nあそこに、いるというわけね…
traducao: Rhubarb Mountains.\nSo it has appeared there...

original: これでまた噂が広まれば、\n向かう人々が増えてしまう…
traducao: If rumors spread further,\nmore people will flock there...

original: これ以上、接触はさせない様にしないと…
traducao: We must prevent anyone from touching it...
